notice_header: STATUTORY NOTICE TO REMEDY DEFAULT OR QUIT — WI
governing_state_statute: Wisconsin Statutes § 704.17 (Notice Terminating Tenancy for Failure to Pay Rent)
federal_compliance: Public Law 116-136, Section 4024 (Federal CARES Act 30-Day Notice Mandate Enforced)

section_8_housing_authority_notice.rule: 24 CFR § 982.310(e)(2)(ii) — Mandatory Landlord Copy to Housing Authority
section_8_housing_authority_notice.service_requirement: Concurrent written copy must be transmitted to the PHA case manager.

state_specific_advisories.financial_assistance_disclosure: You may apply for emergency assistance through Wisconsin Emergency Rental Assistance (WERA) or local CAP agencies.
state_specific_advisories.remedy_instruction: You must pay the total outstanding amount of $780.00 on or before December 07, 2026 or vacate the leased premises. Failure to cure will result in formal unlawful detainer/eviction proceedings.
